 The latest fuel price predictions hint at a R0.50/l price cut for diesel this December
 By Stuff writer November 20, 2026 No Comments 2 Mins Read 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Pinterest 
 Email 
 The last we heard, petrol prices were awaiting a sizeable reduction come December 2026, while diesel motorists faced a minor price hike thanks to the R1.50/l being added back to the levy. Now, according to the Central Energy Fund’s (CEF) latest predictions, things have taken a dramatic turn. Diesel prices are expected to see a price cut large enough to outstrip the National Treasury’s tax. Once the dust has settled, a R0.50/l cut is on the cards.
 Finally, some good news for diesel drivers
 It’s worth mentioning that the prices and figures seen below are not final. The Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR) will officially adjust South Africa’s fuel prices on Wednesday, 2 December. The CEF, in conjunction with the DMPR, tracks the economic factors that influence the price of fuel locally.
 It uses this data to provide daily updates on the coming fuel price adjustments. As such, the figures are subject to change. Should the price of oil climb — the biggest proponent for fuel price hikes — we could be spouting a different story this December. The opposite is also true, with a more stable oil price further cutting prices.
 The Rand/US Dollar also plays a role, albeit a smaller one, in the monthly fuel price changes. In this case, the price of oil has continued to fall as we navigate through November to around $91/barrel — well above the $100+ seen earlier in the year. The Rand has strengthened slightly too, though it only contributes a minor cut here.
 Here are the expected petrol and diesel prices (so far) for December 2026: 
 Petrol 93:  decrease of 344 cents per litre (R3.44)
 Petrol 95: decrease   of 368 cents per litre (R3.68)
 Diesel 0.05%: decrease of 158 cents per litre (R1.58)
 Diesel 0.005%: decrease of 200 cents per litre (R2.00)
 Illuminating Paraffin: decrease   of 261 cents per litre (R2.61)
 Here are the expected petrol and diesel prices for December (after fuel levy adjustments): 
 Petrol 93: decrease   of 294 cents per litre (R2.94)
 Petrol 95:  decrease   of 318 cents per litre (R3.18)
 Diesel 0.05%: decrease of 8 cents per litre (R0.08)
 Diesel 0.005%: decrease of 50 cents per litre (R0.50)
